package dailyassignments;

public class CharacterWrapperClass {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub

		
		char alpha = '7';
		if(Character.isDigit(alpha))
			System.out.println(alpha + " is a Digit");
		else
			System.out.println("Not digit");
		
		
		
		char letter = 'A';
		if(Character.isLetter(letter))
			System.out.println("A is a letter");
		else
			System.out.println("Not a digit");
		
		
		char lCase = 'b';
		if(Character.isLowerCase(lCase))
		{
			char caps = Character.toUpperCase(lCase);	
									
			System.out.println("Converted letter b to uppercase: "+caps);
		}
		else
			System.out.println("Not a digit");
		
			
		
	}

}
